nchs_source_cautions.resident_filter: None in authoritative builder: reads age/order only. Do not label exact sample US-resident births without verification.
nchs_source_cautions.conclusion: Counts exceed published resident total even after age restriction; dataset residence comparability is unverified. Presence/effect of nonresident births is an inference requiring a raw residence-field check; no source correction performed.

unknown_live_birth_order.qualification: Conservative: every unknown-order record could be first order and at either midpoint extreme; no assumption that missingness is random.

nchs_age_tail_collapse.qualification: Collapse preserves the empirical score but assumes early/late births can be represented by boundary model decisions. It does not create pre18 motherhood or maternal age states.

normalization_and_topcoding.initial_fertility_2_1: Author-selected stationary model completed-fertility normalization. Inherited observer uses literal0/1/2/3+ with top-bin representative3.602359422009. Related renewal law divides topcode-adjusted births by2.1. This is not a measured female periodTFR; normalization and entry identities require separate checks.
normalization_and_topcoding.cps_topcode: FREVER is capped at 5 only for the separate CPS mean-completed-fertility diagnostic. The two certified shares do not use that cap.
normalization_and_topcoding.model_top_parity: Any mean-fertility observer must state its representative top-parity weight. Exact-one-among-mothers is identified from literal parity zero/one masses and is not a sequential second-birth hazard.

algebraic_same_distribution_check.qualification: Algebraic conditional diagnostic only: actual 2.1 normalization and CPS age-window observers need not be the same distribution.

normalization_and_topcoding.high_parity_limitation: One terminal3+ state cannot recover the actual distribution of fourth/fifth births. Top-bin mean is an observer restriction, not an extra realized-birth process.
